text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, February 14, 2018 Posted by admin on February 14th, 2018 
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -152 points. 
Tuesday the Dow was up +39.18 (+0.16%) at 24,640.45. 
Year-to-date the Dow is down -0.32%. 
There were 14 Dow stocks up Tuesday. 
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Cisco (CSCO) +1.55% and Wal-Mart (WMT) +1.44%. 
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by DowDupont (DWDP) -1.52% and United Technologies (UTX) -1.26%. 
Miss Market, please be my Valentine… and drop one or two thousand points. 
The Consumer Price Index, a key indicator of inflation trends, jumped 0.5 percent in January, well above market expectations. 
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is down one cent at $2.560 per gallon.
